title: Bride and Groom Exiting Church, 1951 B&W Photograph
description: A black and white photograph capturing a bride and groom exiting a church following their wedding ceremony on November 17, 1951. The bride wears a traditional gown with a long veil while holding hands with the groom, who is dressed in a white dinner jacket and dark trousers. In the background, a bridesmaid in a tiered frilly dress steps out of the church doorway alongside a guest wearing a fedora.
